# Hikari Tractors Indonesia

> Hikari Tractors is an independent tractor spare-parts supplier. The catalog helps buyers identify parts by tractor model, system, exploded diagram, and part number; commercial requests are handled through RFQ.

## Important facts

- Website: https://hikaritractors.com/
- Contact: info@hikaritractors.com | WhatsApp +62 852-8755-1869
- Languages: Indonesian and English
- Catalog use: identify model, system, exploded diagram, and part-number references.
- RFQ: fitment, availability, pricing, freight options, lead time, and terms are confirmed before order acceptance.
- Independence: Hikari Tractors is not presented as an official Kubota website, dealer, or authorized representative. Brand names, model names, and part numbers are used for identification only.
